'''[[Cal Falcone]]''' was the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of the [[Corellian Council]] during the early days of the [[Galactic War|renewed Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Falcone and many other Council members sold out to the Empire and voted to join the Empire in conjunction with [[Darth Decimus]]' invasion, allowing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to gain control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] almost immediately. Falcone was killed by [[Darth Tormen]] several weeks later for failing to suppress the civilian resistance.<ref>{{TORcite|Type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Thin Blue Line|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
If a Bounty Hunter player finished the Imperial Corellia storyline and installed [[Darbin Sull]] as Corellian Prime Minister prior to starting the class mission, "'''The Thin Blue Line'''", Sull will replace Falcone in the opening cutscene. If Sull was killed in the course of the Imperial Corellia storyline or the player were to perform "'''The Thin Blue Line'''" beforehand, Falcone will be featured in the opening cutscene by default.<ref>{{TORcite|Type=faction|Imperial|The Battle of Corellia|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref><ref>{{TORcite|Type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Thin Blue Line|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>
